concept: WAF: L7 protection against SQL injection and XSS
tests: Which service protects a public web application from application-layer attacks (SQL injection, XSS).
expected: AWS WAF with managed rule groups on CloudFront or ALB (or API Gateway) — inspects HTTP requests. Triggers: "SQL injection", "cross-site scripting", "application layer".
why_not: Shield Standard — DDoS protection, not app exploits; security groups and NACLs filter by IP/port, not request content.
